resources.string: Charge other devices on the back of this phone
Put a Qi-compatible phone, earbud case or watch on the back of this phone, centred on the wireless charging coil, with the phone closed. Power sharing delivers about 5 W.
Transmitting is armed. This phone cannot read the charger back, so this shows what was requested, not what the charging firmware is doing.
